verdict.rationale: Rootly's docs name Datadog and Sentry as monitoring tools that send alerts into Rootly. A first-party AWS connector lets Rootly AI read CloudWatch metrics, and a connectors overview covers observability tools generally. Grafana and Prometheus are never mentioned, and no step-by-step setup guide for any of the named integrations appears in the evidence. missing for 10: Grafana integration, Prometheus integration, documented setup steps for Datadog/Sentry/CloudWatch, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, first-party integrations cover my observability stack — Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, Sentry — with documented setup

citations.quote: Alerts arrive **programmatically** from monitoring tools like Datadog, PagerDuty, or Sentry
Connecting AWS lets Rootly AI look up CloudWatch metrics, EC2 instance state, RDS database status, SQS queue depth, and other AWS services during investigations.
Connect observability, code, docs, and cloud tools so Rootly AI can investigate and use provider actions your provider permissions allow.
